title: Sprint 4 — Shell Scripting & Automation
description: Write robust automation scripts, schedule recurring tasks, and manage system environments effectively.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 — Shell Scripting Fundamentals
tickets.description:
Understand variable scoping, text quoting, and parameter manipulation.
Implement conditional logic and loops in your scripts.
Organize code into reusable functions with reliable error handling.

tasks.title: Task 4.1.1 — Variables & Quoting
tasks.description: Develop scripts that properly manage local and global variables, handle text quoting correctly, and manipulate dynamic parameters.

tasks.title: Task 4.1.2 — Control Flow
tasks.description: Create automation scripts that process lists of targets, evaluate their status, and categorize the results based on specific conditions.

tasks.title: Task 4.1.3 — Functions & Error Handling
tasks.description: Refactor complex scripts into modular functions, implementing structured error handling, informative logging, and appropriate exit codes.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — Automation with cron, at & Environment
tickets.description:
Schedule tasks to run automatically at specified intervals.
Configure and persist environment settings across sessions.
Build end-to-end automation pipelines for administrative tasks.

tasks.title: Task 4.2.1 — cron & crontab
tasks.description: Configure the system to execute tasks on a recurring schedule, verifying their successful completion and reviewing their logs.

tasks.title: Task 4.2.2 — Environment Variables
tasks.description: Define and preserve system environment variables, understanding the difference between various types of shell sessions.

tasks.title: Task 4.2.3 — Complete Automation Pipeline
tasks.description: Develop a comprehensive automation workflow that processes historical data, cleans up obsolete files, and delivers a summary report.
